answer.note: O[7:0] at the cycle success first goes high. acc = 0xA5C + 375*37 = 16527, which is 0x08F modulo 4096; O is acc[11:4], so 0x08. The trap is 375 rather than 500: the phase counter suppresses one accumulate in four. Assuming 500 gives 0x2A, which is also a plausible-looking byte.

reset.note: One cycle with rst_n low clears the async resets, including the async-set flops holding the non-zero reset value. Every subsequent cycle runs with rst_n high.

hint: The accumulator does not advance on every cycle. Orbit the two-bit group before extrapolating.
